name: plagx-mcp
description: APA/MLA citations, reference list checks, BibTeX, DOI lookup and an essay draft checker.
long_description:
Free academic writing tools by Plagiarism Checker X.

- **check_draft**: word count, reading time, in-text citations vs. the reference list, word limits, punctuation and basic grammar suggestions.
- **format_references** and **cite_in_text**: APA 7 and MLA 9 reference lists and in-text citations.
- **check_references**: duplicates, invalid DOIs and missing fields.
- **lookup_doi**: metadata for a DOI from the public Crossref registry.
- **bibtex_to_csl** / **csl_to_bibtex**: convert between BibTeX and CSL-JSON.

Everything runs on your computer except DOI lookups, which call the public Crossref and doi.org APIs. No account or API key. These tools give writing suggestions only; they do not detect plagiarism or AI-generated text.
